2. Red Blood Cells (RBCs) and related values:

Recommendations for maintaining healthy blood values:

1. For overall blood health:
- Maintain a balanced diet rich in iron, vitamin B12, and folate
- Include lean meats, leafy greens, and whole grains
- Stay hydrated by drinking plenty of water

2. For immune system (WBCs):
- Get adequate sleep (7-9 hours per night)
- Exercise regularly
- Manage stress
- Consider vitamin C-rich foods
- Maintain good hand hygiene

3. For red blood cells:
- Consume iron-rich foods (lean meats, spinach, beans)
- Include vitamin C to help iron absorption
- Get adequate B12 (found in meat, fish, dairy)

4. For platelets:
- Eat plenty of fresh fruits and vegetables
- Consider foods rich in vitamin K (leafy greens)
- Avoid excessive alcohol consumption

Your values are generally within normal ranges, suggesting good overall health. Continue with regular check-ups and maintain a healthy lifestyle to keep these values optimal. If you notice any unusual symptoms or significant changes in your health, consult with your healthcare provider.
